# Unified AWS Serverless Three-Tier Web Application Architecture

## Executive Summary

This solution provides a fully serverless, globally accessible, secure, and cost-optimized three-tier web application architecture on AWS. It relies entirely on managed AWS services, removing operational burden while delivering enterprise-level security, observability, and scalability. The design adheres to defense-in-depth principles, enforces least-privilege access across all layers, and is fully deployable using Infrastructure-as-Code (recommended: AWS CDK).

---

## 1. High-Level Architecture Summary

---

## 2. Integrated Component Design

### 2.1 Presentation Tier

#### Amazon CloudFront (CDN & Edge Security)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| Distribution Type | Web distribution (HTTPS only) |
| Origins | S3 (static assets), API Gateway (dynamic APIs) |
| Cache Behaviors | /api/* → no caching; /* → cached static content |
| Security | TLS 1.2+, HSTS, AWS WAF |
| Geo-Restriction | Configurable |
| Price Class | PriceClass_All or PriceClass_100 |
| Access Logging | Enabled to S3 |
| Invalidation | Automated via CI/CD |

---

#### Amazon S3 (Static Asset Hosting)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| Bucket Policy | No public access; CloudFront OAC only |
| OAC | Enforced |
| Encryption | SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS |
| Versioning | Enabled |
| Lifecycle Rules | Archive after 30 days |
| Replication | Optional |

---

#### Amazon Cognito (Authentication & Authorization)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| User Pool | Managed directory + federation |
| MFA | TOTP or SMS |
| Password Policy | Minimum 12 characters |
| Token Validity | Access: 1h, Refresh: 30d |
| Identity Pool | Temporary AWS credentials |
| Hosted UI | Via CloudFront |
| Advanced Security | Enabled |
| User Groups | Admin, StandardUser |

---

### 2.2 Business Logic Tier

#### Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| API Type | HTTP API |
| Authorizer | Cognito JWT |
| CORS | Restricted |
| Throttling | 10,000 RPS burst |
| Logging | CloudWatch |
| Stage | prod, staging |
| Custom Domain | Supported |
| mTLS | Optional |

---

#### AWS Lambda (Serverless Compute)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| Runtime | Node.js 20.x or Python 3.12 |
| Memory | 512MB default |
| Timeout | 29 seconds |
| Concurrency | Reserved/provisioned |
| VPC | Private subnets |
| Secrets | From Secrets Manager |
| Layers | Supported |
| DLQ | SQS |
| Tracing | X-Ray enabled |
| Code Signing | Enabled |

---

### 2.3 Data Tier

#### Amazon DynamoDB

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| Billing | On-demand |
| Design | Single-table |
| GSIs | Up to 5 |
| Encryption | KMS |
| PITR | Enabled |
| Streams | Enabled |
| TTL | Enabled |
| Multi-AZ | Built-in |
| Global Tables | Optional |
| DAX | Optional |

---

#### Amazon S3 (Data Tier)

| Attribute | Configuration |
|-----------|----------------|
| Purpose | Storage |
| Encryption | SSE-KMS |
| Versioning | Enabled |
| Access | VPC endpoint |
| Lifecycle | Tiered storage |
| Events | SQS/Lambda |

---

### 2.4 Networking & Security

#### Security Groups

| Security Group | Inbound | Outbound |
|---------------|---------|----------|
| sg-lambda | None | HTTPS 443 |
| sg-dax | TCP 8111 | None |
| sg-vpc-endpoints | HTTPS 443 | None |

---

### 2.5 Observability & Monitoring

#### Logging

- Lambda → CloudWatch
- API Gateway → CloudWatch
- CloudFront → S3 → Athena
- CloudTrail → S3 + CloudWatch
- DynamoDB → Metrics
- WAF → Logs

---

#### AWS X-Ray

- End-to-end tracing across services
- Sampling: 5% default, 100% for errors

---

#### Alerting

- CloudWatch → SNS → Email / PagerDuty / Slack

---

### 2.6 Security Controls

- DDoS: AWS Shield
- WAF: Enabled
- TLS: Enforced
- Auth: Cognito + MFA
- IAM: Least privilege
- Encryption: KMS
- Audit: CloudTrail
- Compliance: AWS Config

---

### 2.7 Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK)

- Modular stack design
- Automated deployments

---

## 3. Key Design Decisions

- HTTP API for lower cost and latency
- DynamoDB On-Demand for flexibility
- Lambda in VPC for security
- Single-table design for efficiency
- CloudFront + S3 for control
- Cognito for AWS-native authentication

---

## 4. Cost Estimation

- Approximate monthly cost: $33
- Fully usage-based

---

## 5. CI/CD Pipeline

- Code push → build → test → deploy
- Staging → production with approval
- Canary deployments supported

---

## 6. High Availability & Disaster Recovery

- Multi-AZ by default
- PITR and replication
- Optional multi-region failover

---

## 7. Validation Checklist

- Serverless architecture
- Pay-as-you-go
- Encryption enabled
- Secure authentication
- Observability implemented
- IaC enabled
- High availability ensured

---

## 8. Future Evolution

- Performance optimization
- Multi-region setup
- Event-driven architecture
- Advanced services integration

---

Aligned with AWS Well-Architected Framework.
